subject: Vendr staging: evidence residency, presign TTL and temporary creds alignment
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@emberhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@vendr.io>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal staging + presign window question

Hi Sofia — thanks for partnering with EmberHealth on the Vendr onboarding. Quick ask from our side as we prepare the bulk evidence upload:

- We plan to push ~18k small files (~5–80KB each) into the Vendr presign flow during the scheduled staging window.
- Our upload tooling assumes a presign TTL of at least 8 hours to accommodate retries and parallel workers.
- We also need the staged evidence to remain in the US region for now (data-residency requirement).

Can you confirm whether Redwood’s Vendr connector can: (a) request presigns with TTL >= 8h, and (b) target the us-east region for the presigned URLs? If not, what’s the recommended approach — a short-lived service account with S3 put permissions vs. extending presign expiry?

We attached a small manifest (ember_staging_manifest.csv) and a suggested presign matrix (vendr_presign_matrix.xlsx) showing file size distribution and concurrency.

Thanks — Lydia
Security Program Manager
EmberHealth

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@emberhealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@vendr.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal staging + presign window question

Hi Lydia — appreciated, and thanks for the manifest. Short answer: we can support both approaches but there are tradeoffs. A few clarifying points below so we can give an exact checklist for your ops team:

1) Presign TTLs: our hosted Vendr connector currently supports presign expirations up to 12 hours for customer uploads routed through our us-east-1 staging buckets. The UI defaults to 1 hour; the longer TTL needs an operator flag we can enable per-upload window.

2) Regional placement: we can ensure the presigned S3 targets are created in us-east-1 for the staging window — the control plane will tag the manifest to lock region. If you later need EU residency, we’d need a different staging workflow (separate bucket and export compliance check).

3) Temporary service account alternative: provisioning a temporary service account with PutObject rights and scoped KMS access is an OK fallback if you need programmatic control of retries and want to avoid presign expiry edge-cases. Downsides: we need a short-lived secret rotation plan and you take on more of the audit surface for uploads.

Proposed next steps:
- We can enable 12h presigns for your scheduled window (please confirm desired window start/end).
- If you want the service-account route, we’ll need a ticket for our infra team to create an ephemeral IAM role and presigned STS policy.

Tom — looped you in to confirm Vendr-side acceptance of 12h presigns and any rate-limiting guidance. Jonas / Mina — can you confirm S3 bucket tagging and a one-time operator enable for extended presigns?

Cheers,
Sofia
Security Integrations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal staging + presign window question

Sofia — noted. Quick operational checklist from infra:  

- We can flip the operator flag to allow up to 12h presigns for the specific Vendr tenant for the window. I’ll need the exact HubSpot id or request id to scope.
- S3 target: will use the us-east-1 staging bucket prefixed with emberhealth/<timestamp>/ — will apply region/custodian tags (region:us; custodian:emberhealth).
- Rate-limiting: suggest throttling to ~400 parallel presigns/sec to avoid vendor API backpressure; we’ll coordinate with Vendr for smooth ingestion.

If the customer prefers the service-account approach: we can generate an ephemeral role with AssumeRole duration 12h and a scoped policy limited to the staging prefix. We will also attach an audit webhook that pushes a signed log to the evidence bucket for your SOC 2 records.

Mina — I’ll open infra ticket INF-3392 and include the manifest + sample ACL.

— Jonas
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@vendr.io>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@emberhealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: EmberHealth - Security Team <security@emberhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal staging + presign window question

Thanks all — EmberHealth: we can accept 12h presigns and will reserve a 6-hour ingestion window (2026-05-07 01:00–07:00 UTC) to process the bulk upload. A few notes:

- We verified concurrent upload capacity for the size profile in your manifest; recommend sticking to Jonas’ 400 parallel presign/sec cap to avoid transient 429s.
- For auditing, we’ll surface per-file ingest events in the Vendr dashboard and provide a CSV ingest report after the job completes.
- Confirmed: us-east-1 staging is fine. If you move evidence later to EU, open a new export request; we’ll advise on cross-region attestations.

I’ll attach the presign acceptance matrix (vendr_presign_matrix.xlsx) and a short onboarding checklist. If Redwood is going to enable the 12h operator flag, that’s sufficient — no need to provision the temporary service account.

Lydia — please reply with the exact confirmation of the staging window (UTC) and we’ll lock the slot in our scheduler.

Best,
Tom Ellis
Onboarding Lead — Vendr
